description.value: At 12th level, when the gambler rolls the maximum possible value on a die, he may bank that die as his ace in the hole for later use. At any time after rolling a die of the same type, but before the result is revealed, the gambler can replace that roll with any value within its range as a free action, expending the ace in the hole die in the process. The gambler may bank only one die of each type at a time. This ability cannot be used when rolling for hit points.
